title: Choo-choo train, Skippy Core's coder, MineBench's own procedure
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8_0), run exactly as MineBench runs a model: its full tool-mode prompt and its repair loop (up to 8 attempts)
verdict: Built on the second of MineBench's attempts (the first wrote grass_block as a bare name, not a string, and the repair prompt fixed it), 6 minutes in all. The whole train is in one line on its track: a black locomotive with yellow bands, a red cab, a coal tender and two long red coaches with rows of windows, with a station house, a platform with lamps and a few trees. Weak: it covers the entire 256 x 256 grid with a dirt plate (most of its 295,315 blocks), so the train is a thin strip in a brown field, and the forms are boxes. Only 6 pieces float.
